title: 第一卷 第23章 深藏不露，众人忌惮
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
聚灵泉前的风波缓缓平息。

    围观的外门弟子陆续散去，林间风声再起，冲淡了方才交手残留的灵力余波。

    只是所有人心中的看法，已然悄然颠覆。

    在此之前，整个外门几乎所有人都默认一个定论：苏玄尘空有千年难遇的极品天灵根，奈何年岁太高、肉身枯朽、寿元微薄，纵使天赋再逆天，也终究是昙花一现，难堪大用。

    可方才那一幕，彻底打碎了众人的固有认知。

    仅有炼气三层修为的百岁老者，硬生生扛住了外门第一天才林辰的炼气九层威压，甚至在招式对拼当中不落下风。

    这份战力，早已超脱了低层修士的常理范畴。

    “没想到苏师兄居然这么能扛，那可是九层巅峰的压迫！”

    “灵力纯度差距太大了，天灵根果然不是普通上品灵根能比的。”

    “以前只觉得他可怜，空有天赋没寿命，现在看来，是我们看走眼了。”

    “连林辰都压不住他，低层里面谁还敢惹这位老人？”

    细碎的议论声在林间此起彼伏，随风飘散。

    不少原本心里打着算盘、想在秘境中趁机欺凌老者、抢夺资源的弟子，此刻彻底熄灭了心中贪念。

    能正面硬撼林辰的存在，绝不是软柿子。

    招惹此人，纯属自讨苦吃。

    人群散开之后，聚灵泉依旧被林辰和他的一众追随者牢牢把持。
content_en:
The storm in front of the Juling Spring slowly subsided.

    The onlookers of the outer disciples dispersed one after another, and the sound of wind in the forest began again, diluting the remaining spiritual aftermath of the exchange just now.

    It's just that everyone's opinions have been quietly subverted.

    Before that, almost everyone in the outer sect had agreed upon one conclusion: Su Xuanchen had the best spiritual root that could only be found in a thousand years, but he was too old, his body was decayed, and his lifespan was meager. Even if his talent was heaven-defying, it would be short-lived and useless.

    But that scene just now completely shattered everyone's inherent understanding.

    A centenarian with only the third level of Qi Refining, he was able to withstand the pressure of the ninth level of Qi Refining, Lin Chen, the number one genius in the outer sect, and even managed to survive the duel of moves.

    This combat power has long gone beyond the common sense of low-level monks.

    "I didn't expect Senior Brother Su to be so able to withstand the pressure of the ninth level!"

    "The difference in the purity of spiritual power is too big. The Heavenly Spiritual Root is indeed not comparable to ordinary high-grade spiritual roots."

    "I used to think that he was pitiful because he only had talent but no longevity. Now it seems that we have made a mistake."

    "Even Lin Chen can't suppress him. Who on the lower floors dares to mess with this old man?"

    Tiny voices of discussion rippled through the forest, drifting in the wind.

    Many disciples who had originally planned to take the opportunity to bully the old man and rob the resources in the secret realm completely extinguished their greed at this moment.

    The person who can challenge Lin Chen head-on is by no means a soft persimmon.

    If you provoke this person, you are asking for trouble.

    After the crowd dispersed, Julingquan was still firmly controlled by Lin Chen and his followers.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 23 Hidden and hidden, everyone is afraid
